name: Entish Restoration

abilities.text: Sacrifice a land. Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, instead search your library for up to three basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

notes: The 'instead' clause is a conditional around the two searches, so exactly one of them happens: three basic lands with ferocious (a creature with power 4 or greater), otherwise two.

issues: If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, INSTEAD search ... up to three — expected exactly one search happens; the condition is checked on resolution, after the land sacrifice — scripted sacrifice first, then conditional{ferocious} then/else with count 3 / count 2, both optional:true (the 'up to'), to battlefield tapped — matches, including the sacrifice-before-check ordering. 3/3 blind scenarios pass

Sacrifice a land. Search ... up to two ... If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, instead ... up to three ... — expected sacrifice on resolution, then exactly one search — three basics if ferocious, otherwise two — tapped, then shuffle — scripted sacrifice {who:'you', what:{types:['Land']}, amount:1}, then conditional {kind:'ferocious'} (characteristics.ts:417 = a creature you control with power >= 4) with then=search count 3 / else=search count 2, both basic-only, to battlefield, tapped, optional:true ('up to'). Search op shuffles on both the found and empty paths (game.ts:1229-1240). 3/3 scenarios pass — CR 701.16, 608.2
